rounds.q: What % of US homes use air conditioning?
rounds.why: It's 93% of homes in the South but only 73% in the West.
rounds.src: US EIA, Residential Energy Consumption Survey (2020)
rounds.fun: Nearly nine in ten homes stay cool with AC. Ahh, sweet relief.

rounds.q: What % of US households own the home they live in?
rounds.why: It's 79% when the head of the home is 65+, but 35% when they're under 35.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, Housing Vacancies and Homeownership (Q2 2026)
rounds.fun: About two out of three households own their place. Welcome home!

rounds.q: What % of US homes cook with natural gas?
rounds.why: It's 70% of homes in California but just 8% of homes in Florida.
rounds.src: US EIA, Residential Energy Consumption Survey (2020)
rounds.fun: Gas or electric? Fewer than four in ten homes cook with gas.

rounds.q: What % of US adults ages 18 to 24 live in their parents' home?
rounds.why: By ages 25 to 34, only 16% still live in their parents' home.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, America's Families and Living Arrangements (2025)
rounds.fun: More than half of 18 to 24 year olds live at home. Hi, Mom!

rounds.q: What % of US homes have two or more refrigerators?
rounds.why: About a third of homes, 33%, also have a separate freezer.
rounds.src: US EIA, Residential Energy Consumption Survey (2020)
rounds.fun: One in three homes has a backup fridge. More room for leftovers!
